Singapore, Thailand,
Timor Leste, and Vietnam,
fully support the
establishment of the Southeast Asian Center for Lifelong Learning for Sustainable
Development (SEA-CLLSD) in the Philippines;
under the Implementing
Rules and Regulations of EO No.
483, the Center has to collaborate
in putting the Education for Sustainable
Development
in the educational
early childhood
basic education,
technical-vocational
programs and teacher training
the United Nations has designated UNESCO to be the lead
agency to implement
the Decade of Education for Sustainable
Development,
2005-2014;
the SEA-CLLSD uses the functional
definition
standardized by UNESCO and links to lifelong learning citing UNESCO's role as
task manager of Chapter 36 of Agenda 21, emphasizing that ESD is for everyone
at all stages of life and in all possible learning contexts;
the SEA-CLLSD, as a research and resource management
center, will link with the DepEd, TESDA, CHED, and other service providers
towards lifelong learning and education for sustainable development;

NOW, THEREFORE,
MACAPAGAL-ARROYO,
President of i
the Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by law, do hereby establish:
the Southeast Asian Center for Lifelong Learning for Sustainable Development
(SEA-CLLSD), as an inter-agency
coordinating
body for lifelong
learning for
sustainable
development.
In addition,
its operations,
:
personnel, facilities and expertise, the amount necessary to finance the operation,
of the Center shall be included in the Annual General Appropriations
by Congress, under the name of SEA-CLLSD. This act will amend
Executive Order 483 dated December 27, 2005.
I have hereunto set my hand and caused the
seal of the Republic of the Philippines to be affixed.
